name: Slave or Lovers ~Osananajimi Reizoku Nikki~
original_name: スレイブ or ラバーズ～幼馴染隷属日記～
source: Emi Sawamiya is the classmate and childhood friend of the protagonist, Yuichi Kariya. From a young age they have competed for the best grades. However, Yuichi has often won, and Emi is unconvinced. After school one day, Emi called him to a less popular place and declared that they compete in the next prefectures mock exam. If he loses, he can listen to what the other party says for a week. Time passed, and the results of the mock test results were announced. Yuichi won by a close margin. Then he gets an erection, which angers Emi.
translation: 泽宫惠美是主人公狩谷勇一的同班同学兼青梅竹马。两人从小便不断争夺年级第一，但勇一往往更胜一筹，惠美始终不服气。某天放学后，她把勇一叫到僻静处，提出用下次全县模拟考试决胜：输家接下来一周必须对赢家言听计从。时间流逝，模拟考试成绩终于公布，勇一以微弱优势获胜。随后他竟然勃起，惹恼了惠美。
